note: cdrama/only-pack: substituted for the runbook's suggested 琅琊榜/Nirvana in Fire — confirmed via direct assrt search (both '琅琊榜' and 'Nirvana in Fire' as query strings) that assrt genuinely has ZERO entries for that title, so it was skipped per the runbook's own escape hatch ('if a title yields no usable assrt result after a couple tries, SKIP it'). 西游记 (1986 CCTV classic, TMDB treats it as a single 25-episode season) has a whole-series pack (assrt:666513, '西游记(1986)(简体中文)', 26 files: 01.ass..26.ass, plain-numbered with no season/episode substring — same only-pack shape as the anime/only-pack anchor cell). The recorded search query is the pack's own videoname verbatim (rather than the task's title/originalTitle) specifically so it is the SOLE candidate at index 0 — the earlier trial recording with title='西游记'/original='Journey to the West' surfaced 32 noisy candidates (BD-box compilations, unrelated Doraemon/Journey-to-the-West-2013-movie hits) and resolved detail/download against the WRONG top candidate (a '央视四大名著04' disc that is not this pack); that recording was discarded and re-minted against the exact pack title. Only fileIndex 0 (episode 1, '01.ass', 42KB) has a recorded detail+download; the worker must pick the pack's first entry as episode 1 by plain numeric filename, exactly the only-pack pattern already proven by the anime anchor cell.
